eyebrow: Routing callers to their nearest region
code:
# Illustrative: global routing layer directing each
# caller to its nearest healthy inference endpoint
az network front-door create \
  --resource-group ai-inference-rg \
  --name global-inference-fd \
  --backend-address us-east-infer.internal \
  --backend-address eu-west-infer.internal
caption: A global routing layer, not one central endpoint, is what actually lowers latency across regions.
